meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 激活后,当你明确要求先做规划,Claude 会进入规划模式:只读探索项目代码,判断需求是明确还是模糊;必要时提问,经你批准后产出一份决策完整的工作计划,本身不写产品代码。
howto.when: 仅当用户本人明确要求时触发,如说出“ulw-plan”“plan this”等触发词,或用自己的话要求在写代码前先做计划;平时或仅读本说明不会自动激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给我的登录功能先做实施计划,先别写代码。
say.note: 触发规划模式,先探索再写计划。

say.text: plan this: 把上传模块拆成可执行任务清单,等我批准。
say.note: 进入计划模式,不会自动执行。

say.text: interview me,我想先聊需求细节,边问边做计划。
say.note: 按你的要求主动向你提问,而不是替你默认。

howto.what_en: When active on an explicit planning request, Claude becomes a planner: it explores the codebase read-only, classifies intent, asks only necessary questions, then after your approval writes one decision-complete work plan — it never edits code.
howto.when_en: Only on your explicit request, e.g. saying ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, interview me, or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. Never self-activates without it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to draft the login implementation plan; don't code yet.
say_en.note: Turns on plan mode: explore first, then a plan.

say_en.text: Plan this: split the upload module into tasks, then wait for my OK.
Interview me: I'd like to discuss details while you plan.
say_en.note: Asks the forks you own instead of defaulting silently.
